notes: Cover panel re-shoot of kavita-24-surkh: standing, full length, headroom for the tall crop.
prompt: Editorial fashion photograph for an Indian handloom label's festive lookbook. Tall vertical 9:16 frame.
GARMENT (a real product; match the reference photos exactly, including colours, borders and motifs):
- Saree: the bright red mul cotton saree from the first three references, with delicate black thread line-embroidery of flowers and leaves on the pallu and small tassels. Matte, light.
- Blouse: the black blouse from the last reference, elbow-length sleeves with a woven red-and-black border at the cuffs.
- Pallu over the shoulder and held out slightly in one hand so the black floral embroidery is clearly visible.
MUSE: a woman in her early thirties with wavy dark hair pinned up loosely, red lips, a small black bindi, a stack of black and red glass bangles; a fierce, warm half-smile straight to camera.
MOMENT AND PLACE: A palash grove at sunset: she stands among the trees, fallen flame-orange palash flowers on the ground around her, bare branches with blossoms framing the sky above.
LIGHT: Low sunset light from behind, flame-orange glow, the red saree vivid against it.
COVER FRAMING (this photograph becomes one tall, narrow panel of the lookbook's opening page, behind a large title):
- POSE: she is standing upright, full length, head to toe in frame; ignore any seated or kneeling pose mentioned above.
- HEADROOM: the top quarter of the frame is calm, empty background (sky, wall, foliage or soft darkness); her head sits about a quarter of the way down, never near the top edge.
- Subject centred horizontally and filling the middle third of the width, so a narrow vertical crop keeps all of her.
- Keep the background simple and softly out of focus; nothing busy behind her face.
- CAMERA: eye level, 50mm lens at f/2.8, gentle depth of field, medium-format look with fine grain.
